claims.claim: Automatic Plastic Bottle Making Machine used in production to make PET plastic bottles
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an industrial sealing machine with a horizontal sealing/pressing bar; witness identity is industrial sealing machine, not a bottle-making machine.

risks.risk: Whether the machine powers on and operates.
risks.proof: Video of the machine powering on and completing a sealing cycle.

risks.risk: Condition of the heating or sealing element.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the sealing element/bar and a test seal on sample material.
Photo of the nameplate or serial plate showing manufacture date.

risks.risk: Hours of use or usage history.
risks.proof: Photo of hour meter or maintenance log showing usage.

risks.risk: Whether dies, molds, or change parts are included.
risks.proof: Photo of all included dies, molds, or change parts.
Photo of nameplate showing voltage, phase, and power draw.
risks.if_unproven: as unknown or incompatible power needs

risks.risk: Working condition of motor, electronics, and sensors.
risks.proof: Video of full operation showing motor, electronics, and sensors functioning.

risks.risk: Whether manuals, tools, or accessories are included.
risks.proof: Photo of manuals, tools, and accessories.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and completing a sealing cycle
Photo of the nameplate or serial plate
Photo of any included dies, molds, or change parts
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as an industrial sealing machine, contradicting the seller's bottle-making claim, but the type is known enough to price at worst case. Operating condition, tooling, and power requirements remain unproven.
